title: Examples check result
description: Daily reconciliation of upstream example trees against examples_manifest.yaml (design: docs/examples-check-design.md). One aggregate result.json per run; per-project status is success / failed / error / skipped.

trigger.description: How this run was started (schedule / workflow_dispatch / manual).

workflows_ref.description: Commit SHA of this repository the check ran from.

not_in_scope.description: Projects that have an examples_manifest.yaml but no thin workflow calling the engine (guard not brought up); reported in the step summary, not checked.

project.description: Project name (= projects/<project>/ directory, from the thin workflow's with.project).

scan_repo.description: Repository whose example tree was reconciled: with.examples_repo when set, else with.upstream_repo.

target_ref.description: Reconciliation ref: latest release tag, or the fallback branch name. Empty for skipped (no fetch).

ref_source.description: How target_ref was resolved. Absent for skipped.

tree_sha.description: git tree SHA of the scanned tree (traceability).

scanned_count.description: Number of reconciliation units scanned upstream.

recorded_count.description: Number of recorded entries (supported upstream paths + unsupported strings).

missing_paths.description: Upstream units not covered by any exclude/supported/unsupported entry. Non-empty => failed.

stale_paths.description: Covering entries (supported/unsupported/exclude) that match no upstream unit. Info only, never fails.

detail.description: error reason (config / fetch-failed / scan-root-missing) or skipped reason; empty otherwise.
